notes:
Account snapshot: Spectra CrossIndexing is a European-focused knowledge search platform serving major financial and legal customers. They ingest multilingual corpora (EN, FR, DE, ES, NL, PT, IT, PL) and need per-language recall/precision tuning for regulatory search and discovery. POC scope: 50M doc index (initial), scale-to 500M over 12 months; vector dims currently 1536 (custom), expect moving to mixed dims for language-specific encoders.

Key constraints: EU data residency mandatory, must support VPC/private deployment for sensitive customers, some on-prem installations for air-gapped clients. Strong appetite for dedicated capacity but want hosted API for small customers; cost per query target ~$0.01-0.02 for embedding+rerank (3–4 candidates reranked). Latency targets: cold-query end-to-end <350ms, reranker tail (p95) <150ms.

Architecture preferences discussed on call: hybrid store where embeddings live in a fast vector DB (local/dedicated) and reranker runs on dedicated GPU pool per language cluster. They plan language-aware retrieval: language detection -> language-specific ANN index + per-language reranker finetuned on domain prompts. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to hit cost targets.

Quote from CTO (paraphrase): "We need per-language recall numbers, not just global MAP. If French recall drops by 8% after quantization, we can't ship. Provide measurable evals per locale."

Risk notes: legal asks for KMS integration + audit log retention 7 years for some customers; PII redaction during indexing is required for legal documents. Technical: existing vector pipeline built on FAISS/pinecone hybrid; will evaluate Redwood's routing/fallback (model variants) for cost-sensitive tiers.

Recent comms: SE demo 2026-02-18 (ff-2026-02-18-8453), security FAQ shared (drive link). Procurement timeline driven by two key customers onboarding in Q2.

Short bullets (sales-style):
- POC: 50M docs, goal: prove <150ms rerank p95 on EN/FR/DE + MAP parity vs current baseline
- Success metrics: per-language recall/precision >= baseline, cost/q <= $0.02, replication to on-prem node validated
- Decision makers: CTO (Jaime Correa), Head of Search (Ines Meyer), Legal (K. Novak)
- Next: answer Redwood security questionnaire + schedule on-prem POC window
